gdm->cad.title: GDM to CAD Metabolic Risk Management
recommendations: Schedule postpartum Oral Glucose Tolerance Test (OGTT) at 6-12 weeks after delivery.
Perform annual fasting lipid panel, HbA1c, and blood pressure monitoring.
Implement low-glycemic dietary planning and 150 min/week moderate aerobic exercise.
Consult Cardiology for early cardiovascular risk assessment if dyslipidemia or hypertension develops.

gdm->ckd.title: GDM to CKD Renal Microvascular Protection
recommendations: Order annual urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio (uACR) and estimated GFR (eGFR) screenings.
Maintain strict glycemic targets (HbA1c < 6.5%) to prevent renal microvascular injury.
Screen early for signs of diabetic kidney disease.

preeclampsia->cad.title: Preeclampsia Postpartum Cardiovascular Screening
recommendations: Establish lifetime cardiovascular risk tracking following a hypertensive disorder of pregnancy.
Monitor blood pressure, fasting lipids, and glucose every 6-12 months postpartum.
Consider non-invasive coronary imaging or Calcium Scoring (CAC) in mid-life.

preeclampsia->stroke.title: Preeclampsia Cerebrovascular Risk Reduction
recommendations: Enforce strict blood pressure control (target < 130/80 mmHg).
Educate patient on warning signs of acute cerebrovascular events (FAST protocol).
Evaluate for persistent postpartum hypertensive vascular dysfunction.

preeclampsia->ckd.title: Preeclampsia Postpartum Renal Injury Prevention
recommendations: Check spot urine protein-to-creatinine ratio postpartum until protein excretion normalizes.
Monitor serum creatinine and eGFR at 3 and 6 months post-delivery.

ckd->cad.title: Cardiorenal Risk Reduction (CKD -> CAD)
recommendations: Co-manage patient care with Nephrology and Cardiology specialist teams.
Monitor calcium-phosphate product and vascular calcification markers.
Optimize blood pressure management with RAAS inhibitors (ACEi/ARB) as clinically indicated.

cad->ckd.title: Cardiorenal Perfusion Protection (CAD -> CKD)
recommendations: Avoid nephrotoxic agents (e.g., NSAIDs, iodinated contrast) where possible.
Optimize cardiac output and hemodynamics to preserve renal perfusion.

cad->stroke.title: Atherosclerotic Cerebrovascular Protection (CAD -> Stroke)
recommendations: Initiate guideline-directed statin and antiplatelet therapy.
Screen for carotid artery stenosis and atrial fibrillation.

stroke->cad.title: Systemic Atherothrombotic Management (Stroke -> CAD)
recommendations: Perform baseline ECG and echocardiogram to evaluate silent coronary artery disease.
Optimize systemic vascular risk factors including BP and LDL cholesterol.

gdm->preeclampsia.title: Gestational Vascular & Placental Stress Monitoring
recommendations: Initiate low-dose aspirin (81-150 mg/day) starting at 12 weeks gestation if indicated.
Frequent antenatal monitoring of blood pressure, urine protein, and fetal growth.

preeclampsia->gdm.title: Gestational Placental-Metabolic Monitoring
recommendations: Perform early 24-28 week glucose tolerance screening during current or future pregnancies.
Monitor nutritional intake and maternal weight gain trajectory.

gdm: Follow diabetic pregnancy management guidelines with endocrinology care.
Monitor blood glucose levels 4 times daily (fasting and 1-hr postprandial).
preeclampsia: Urgent obstetrical evaluation for signs of preeclampsia with severe features.
Assess lab parameters (platelets, liver enzymes, serum creatinine).
stroke: Immediate neurological risk evaluation and brain/carotid vascular imaging if symptomatic.
Strict BP control and stroke prevention protocol.
ckd: Nephrology consultation for staging and nephroprotective management.
Strict BP target (< 120/80 mmHg if proteinuria present) and dietary sodium restriction.
cad: Cardiology consultation, diagnostic stress testing, or coronary angiography as indicated.
Lifestyle modification and anti-ischemic medical therapy.
